title: Three Straight Axes: The Gantry, the Time of a Straight Line Across Axes of Different Strength, and What a Long Beam Does to Accuracy

artifact.note: the Cartesian gantry: three straight axes with their own speed and acceleration limits; the time of a move when each axis goes on its own and when the tool is to go in a straight line (the line's speed and acceleration are set by the weakest axis for its share of the direction); the sag of a crossbeam under a load at its middle, the stiffness it gives and the first resonance with the moving mass; and the skew of a beam driven from both ends when the two ends are out of step
